gray_dilation_rect — 2D rank op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "gray_dilation_rect", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: gray_dilation_rect (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Grayscale dilation that returns the maximum value within a rectangular window (`ndimage.maximum_filter). It fills in dark thin lines and small holes from the bright side, the counterpart operation to gray_erosion_rect. Equivalent to HALCON's gray_dilation_rect` (Determine the maximum gray value within a rectangle.).
